text:
Dear Ms Kaufmann,

I'm following up on the theft at my flat, Hauptstrasse 37 in Zug, on 11 February 2026. My laptop, my good headphones and a gold bracelet were taken from my home that day, CHF 7,000 in total by my reckoning.

No locks or keys had to be changed afterwards, and I'm not claiming anything for keys or locks.

I've also done everything there is to do to keep the loss down. The serial numbers went to the police the same week, the laptop is registered as stolen with the manufacturer, and I changed every password that was saved on it. There's nothing further on my list.

Attached is the claim form, filled in and signed.

And yes, I have the original receipts for all three items, the laptop and headphones from the electronics shop in town and the bracelet from the jeweller who sold it to me in 2024. They're in the folder where I keep all my paperwork, so that part at least is easy.

Best wishes,
Isla Zimmermann
